calculation_notes_for_evaluator: Expected values were computed from open stores using signed_off monthly_store_close rows. Q4 is 2026-10 to 2026-12 and Q3 is 2026-07 to 2026-09. Net sales = gross_sales - return_value. Labor productivity = Q4 net sales / Q4 labor_hours. Return rate = Q4 return_value / Q4 gross_sales. Staffing coverage = covered_hours / scheduled_hours. These notes are evaluator-only.
alignment_note: Every grounded score-2 requirement is supported by task.md plus env/ops_review_notes.md or env/close_feed_glossary.md: periods, final close context, current operating locations, net sales after returns, quarter lift, labor productivity, return pressure, staffing coverage, region context, and no raw SQL/table export.
